name: Compliance and Risk
summary: Insurance policies, obligations, incidents and risk records.
purpose: Record insurance and compliance facts so that reporting, renewals and risk management can be automated. The standard records facts; it does not assess legal compliance.
inScope: Insurance policies, coverages, limits and deductibles

planned.name: ComplianceObligation
planned.description: A recurring obligation such as an inspection or filing with a due date.

planned.name: Incident
planned.description: An event such as a flood or fire affecting the strata corporation.

planned.name: InspectionFinding
planned.description: A deficiency or recommendation from an inspection.

planned.name: RiskRecord
planned.description: An identified risk and its mitigation.

openIssues.title: Statutory insurance summary
openIssues.description: Any summary of statutory insurance requirements must be legally reviewed before publication.
